code_first_findings.finding: Four independent heartbeat SharedPreferences getters could straddle committed maps and manufacture a false byte/SHA integrity wound.
A coherent storage read failure had no bounded retryable owner semantics.
code_first_findings.resolution: Owner preserves the existing scene with STORAGE_READ_FAILURE_BOUNDARY and does not advance heartbeatProcessedPersistedSnapshot.

code_first_findings.finding: OperatorOverlayService.applyHeartbeatModelChrome still labels any zero-control interrupted frame as CONTACT HELD. A read failure before first accepted contact has no visiblePulseId, so that visible label would overclaim contact.
code_first_findings.source_repair_prepared: HeartbeatOverlayViewModel.Model.summaryVisibleLabel() now distinguishes REFRESH BLOCKED from CONTACT HELD, with regression source, but the existing service does not yet consume that helper.
code_first_findings.required_next_cut: Make existing applyHeartbeatModelChrome consume model.summaryVisibleLabel(); no new renderer/controller.
